title: Lost Umbrella
theme: Warm stop-motion claymation look, handmade miniature sets, symmetrical framing, soft 35mm grain, rainy-city pastels, golden practical lights.
cast: JUNE: woman in her 30s, short grey bob, green raincoat, red umbrella with a white handle. PIP: a small round delivery robot with one blue eye and an orange flag.

shots.title: Left behind
shots.action: June runs off a tram. Her red umbrella stays on the seat.
shots.vo: Every day, a million umbrellas go missing.
shots.image: Wide shot of a pastel tram interior in the rain. JUNE hurries out of the doors; her red umbrella lies on the empty seat.
shots.motion: The doors close; the tram pulls away; the umbrella slides on the seat.

shots.title: Pip finds it
shots.action: Pip scans the seat, tags the umbrella and sets off through the rain.
shots.image: Close shot of PIP rolling up to the tram seat, its blue eye scanning the red umbrella with a soft light.
shots.motion: Pip's eye scans, a small chime, Pip lifts the umbrella onto its back.

shots.title: Reunited
shots.action: Pip finds June at a bus stop and hands back the umbrella.
shots.image: JUNE at a rainy bus stop, surprised and smiling as PIP holds up her red umbrella.
shots.motion: June takes the umbrella and opens it over both of them.
